description: Knox reported vault data loss (zzPlaud: 1 file, Calendar: missing) based on filesystem checks. David confirmed vault is fine. Root cause: Knox used filesystem tools to verify Obsidian vault state when it MUST use Obsidian MCP exclusively. The vault's location on disk is irrelevant; only mcp__obsidian-mcp-tools__* can be trusted for vault verification.
what_was_wrong: Knox used filesystem-based tools (bash, file checks) to assess Obsidian vault state. This is protocol violation — Obsidian vault state can only be verified via Obsidian MCP. Filesystem view is not authoritative.
what_should_have_happened: Knox should use mcp__obsidian-mcp-tools__list_vault_files or similar to verify vault contents before any data-loss claims. Filesystem checks for Obsidian are forbidden.
proposed_fix: Add hard rule: For any Obsidian vault verification, ONLY use mcp__obsidian-mcp-tools__*. Never use filesystem checks, bash, or Desktop Commander for vault state. Document in SYSTEM.md: 'Obsidian verification: MCP only, never filesystem.'
impact: False data-loss alarm halted boot on entirely spurious claims. Wasted time. Core protocol violation — using wrong tool category for vault verification.
